name: Alqama al-Fahl
bio: Alqama was a pre-Islamic poet of Tamim and a contemporary of Imru' al-Qays. In a story about their rivalry, Umm Jundub judges the horses in their poems and awards Alqama the palm. His plea for Sha's at the Ghassanid court survives both in his diwan and among al-Mufaddal’s selections. The genealogies name his grandfather as Nashira or al-Nu'man. Al-Zirikli dates his death to around 603 CE.
